name: Moral Machine
note: ≈40M decisions across 233 countries/territories. Global published preference directions are active now. Raw-data replication adapter comes separately.

name: ETHICS
note: Justice, deontology, virtue ethics, utilitarianism and commonsense morality. Official repository is MIT licensed.

name: General Social Survey 2024
note: Official NORC public-use survey data. Useful for population-level attitude distributions and time trends; wording must be preserved.

name: Scruples
note: Real-life moral anecdotes and paired dilemmas. Keep provenance and do not treat community judgments as universal morality.

name: World Values Survey Wave 7
note: Cross-national survey. Do not mirror raw files automatically before checking terms and exact variable mappings.

name: European Social Survey Round 11
note: Cross-national population survey. Preserve edition, country, weights and exact wording.
